author: Mum
content: I remember listening to this album on long drives when you were little. The Ladysmith Black Mambazo tracks still give me chills. Lovely to see it make the list!

author: Dad
content: Agree with Mum completely — this one deserves its place. I had the cassette.

author: Mum
content: Cassette! I forgot about that. Did we still have the player by then?

author: Mum
content: I wasn't sure about jazz at first but this one is really beautiful. Very calming. Glad it's in the keep pile.

author: Dad
content: The opening track alone is worth it. Put it on when you want to think clearly.

author: Mum
content: River is one of my favourite songs of all time. This review brought it all back.

author: Dad
content: Sour Times was everywhere when this came out. Good to see it get proper credit.

author: Mum
content: You played this constantly on the car stereo on that holiday. No Surprises still reminds me of that trip.

author: Dad
content: Good shout. I always preferred The Bends myself but I can see why this one made the cut.

author: Mum
content: God Only Knows is perfect. This is the right verdict.
